# DermaDot

> DermaDot offers scalp micropigmentation (SMP) consultations and treatments in Athens, Greece.

The website provides information in Greek and English about SMP, its applications, treatment planning, the procedure, aftercare, and consultation requests.

## Main pages

- Greek home: https://dermadot.plus/
- English home: https://dermadot.plus/en
- Greek SMP information: https://dermadot.plus/info
- English SMP information: https://dermadot.plus/en/info
- Greek applications: https://dermadot.plus/applications
- English applications: https://dermadot.plus/en/applications
- Greek SMP technique: https://dermadot.plus/what-is-smp
- English SMP technique: https://dermadot.plus/en/what-is-smp
- Greek SMP or hair transplant guide: https://dermadot.plus/treatment-guide
- English SMP or hair transplant guide: https://dermadot.plus/en/treatment-guide
- Greek practitioner information: https://dermadot.plus/doctor
- English practitioner information: https://dermadot.plus/en/doctor
- Greek procedure: https://dermadot.plus/procedure
- English procedure: https://dermadot.plus/en/procedure
- Greek aftercare: https://dermadot.plus/aftercare
- English aftercare: https://dermadot.plus/en/aftercare
- Greek consultation: https://dermadot.plus/contact
- English consultation: https://dermadot.plus/en/contact
- Frequently asked questions: https://dermadot.plus/faq
